name: LanguageTool
summary: Open-source grammar and spell checker with a free browser extension.
gains: Free tier covers spelling and grammar everywhere you type
Can be self-hosted for full privacy
tradeoffs: Fewer style/tone rewrites on the free tier
Pair it with your local AI for rewrites
setupSteps: Turn on the Google Docs integration
Cancel Grammarly once you're happy (export any custom dictionary first)
freeTierLimits: Free tier focuses on spelling and grammar; advanced style suggestions are paid.
